missing_components.description: Missing workflow for tracking expired adoptions and notifying customers.
Missing relationship for Feed to Supplier entity to manage supplier information more effectively.

risks.description: Lack of UI for detailed order management and fulfillment tracking could affect user experience.
risks.impact: High - Direct impact on customer service and operational efficiency.

risks.description: The absence of workflows for managing subscription renewals automatically may lead to manual errors.
risks.impact: Medium - Could lead to lapses in subscription services, affecting customer satisfaction.

recommendations.action: Add detailed UI modules for order management, including options to view and edit orders, manage fulfillment statuses, and track order history.
Develop a workflow for managing the expiration of adoption programs, including notifications and follow-ups.
Incorporate a supplier relationship entity to manage and interact with suppliers for the feed inventory effectively.
Implement automated workflows or business logic to manage CSA and other subscription renewals or cancellations more efficiently.
